newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU to brief E.European partners after June summit.
newsitem.headline: EU to brief E.European partners after June summit.

text.p: The European Union will brief central and eastern European countries on June 27 on the outcome of its Amsterdam summit, a Dutch foreign ministry spokeswoman said on Monday.
She said the June 16-17 summit was expected to be so intensive that there would probably not be enough time for an anticipated meeting with prospective EU members.
"At the end of a summit there's always a meeting with associated countries," the spokeswoman said. "We want to have a special meeting to tell them the results of the summit."
The spokeswoman said the meeting, also in Amsterdam, would be attended by central and east European countries.

The Netherlands currently holds the revolving six-monthly presidency of the EU. The Amsterdam summit is expected to thrash out a new treaty which could pave the way for accession talks with a number of ex-communist states from eastern Europe.
